findings.text: follow-on: run_parallel_file_discovery resolves its default min_score through get_discovery_threshold() (0.90) and passes it to claim_paths_for_file_scan, which now gates on p.scan_relevance, so a library caller that names no min_score still gates the code-scan path selection at 0.90 while the CLI path passes 0.30; the done_when states the 0.9 threshold no longer gates code-scan path selection. This file is outside the node's write scope, so it is recorded rather than repaired.

follow-on: discover status --json reports high-value paths through get_high_value_paths(facility, min_score=get_discovery_threshold(), limit=20), and get_high_value_paths now filters p.scan_relevance, so this status surface still gates at 0.90 while the discover paths summary uses 0.30; the two surfaces disagree on which paths are high value. Outside the node's write scope.

follow-on: _async_score_with_llm re-implements the describe-then-judge pipeline (same description system prompt, same description/paths match assertion, same judge_rows call and path_judgment_fields) already written at scorer.py:354; the duplicated wiring should be extracted so the description-and-judge step has one owner.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 849a1a35fadb419a3d4cfe1b07795fbd233fdca0 into a1a8a63babcfe740204853bc859910e94d532f75; the six commits rewrite scorer.py and parallel.py to route decisions through judge_rows and rename the path gate to get_path_scan_threshold.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/discovery/test_path_judgments.py, test_scorer.py and test_paths_progress.py with baseline and after logs, and the manifest records those runs; the recorded gate (94 passed baseline at 07477c79b, 95 passed after at a1a8a63ba, EXIT=0 both) asserts the measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to deploy Jev path judgments into path discovery and its gates; the diff replaces the LLM triage/score prompts with a description model plus the shared judge_rows in imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py, storing path_purpose Choice, eleven facet Scores with probs and confidence, children_worth_listing and judgment_model.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the focused gate result, the widened 158-path AUC 0.886 against the original 0.807, spend USD 0.003404436 of USD 3, and names its gate, mutation and rollback logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; all 13 changed source and test files plus the one evidence fragment lie inside them, and the changed_paths list names two test files (test_scorer.py, test_paths_progress.py) that the diff does not touch.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_path_judgments.py:1918 test_code_scan_claim_uses_judged_facets reddens on reinstating p.score_composite in the claim (scan-gate-negative-control-final.log EXIT=1), and test_rescoring_preserves_enriched_metadata reddens when the unconditional-write is restored (score-preservation-negative-control-final.log EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: the after gate at imas_codex/discovery/paths/scorer.py has its result recorded in path-review-after-committed.log (95 passed EXIT=0) and the calibration figure in docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/path-jev-deploy.html is backed by metrics-widened.json.
justifications.fit: the module keeps the surrounding style of imas_codex/discovery/paths/models.py, the new get_path_scan_threshold follows settings.py:1012 and no name the repository's naming rules forbid is introduced.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/paths/scorer.py:88 path_judgment_fields computes the scan, expand and enrich gates in code from the judged facets and parallel.py:2462 scores through the shared judge_rows, delivering the §4 design.
justifications.reuse: the judging loop extends the owner judge_rows in imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:136, but the describe-then-judge wiring is duplicated between scorer.py:354 and parallel.py:2395 without a shared owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (imas_codex/discovery/paths/*, imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py, imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml, imas_codex/settings.py, tests/discovery/test_path_judgments.py) is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
